title: Haitian Creole Foundations
subtitle: From first Kreyòl sounds to your first everyday conversation.
description: An A0-to-A1 Haitian Creole course that develops listening, speaking, reading, sentence building, and writing together from the first module.
audience: True beginners with no prior Haitian Creole required.
Learners who want practical everyday Kreyòl with listening and speaking from the beginning.
prerequisites: Ability to read short English instructions.
goals: Build a reliable sound-to-spelling foundation in Kreyòl.
Use greetings, identity language, everyday objects, actions, questions, numbers, and time.
Finish by understanding and producing a short first Kreyòl conversation.
